# **How Swipe made billing effortless for G1 Clothing**


Guru, the creator of G1 Clothing fame, has been in the apparel business since five years ago. Swipe has been aiding him in his daily task for the last three long years by making invoicing less of a hassle for him alone in terms giving him some respite with the billing process.


For businesses that need to produce invoices quickly and deliver them without much fuss to clients, convenience matters. That’s what Guru noted is among the biggest benefits of using Swipe.


## **Why did G1 Clothing choose Swipe**


One of the biggest advantages Guru found in Swipe was its simplicity.


Unlike tools that depend completely on a mobile application, Swipe can also be accessed directly through a browser. This allows the G1 Clothing team to manage billing without constantly worrying about app installations, frequent updates, device compatibility, or switching between different platforms.


The straightforward interface also makes routine billing faster and easier to manage.


## **What makes Swipe useful for G1 Clothing**


In a clothing company, billing is one of the fundamental parts of the business operations. Hence, it has to be carried out quickly in order to not lose time being held up by customers and employees.


Thanks to Swipe, G1 Clothing has been able to make billing simpler.


What impressed Guru the most was the integration with WhatsApp.


The invoices are generated via Swipe and are sent directly to customers using WhatsApp.


Since the business does not have to do any extra work after generating the invoice, it can look more professional while billing.


## **How Swipe changed the team's billing workflow**


When Swipe was adopted at G1 Clothing, Guru found many changes in the billing:


- The overall billing procedure became streamlined and more manageable.
- There was no need for long training for employees to use Swipe properly.
- Customers can receive their invoices on WhatsApp.
- A web-based app reduced the necessity to download and install any additional software.
- Everybody in the café was able to process invoices without much help from outside.


Guru also mentions that during the three years of working with Swipe, he has very rarely reached out to the customer support of the company, as the app functions perfectly and meets the business needs.


## **Why Guru recommends Swipe to other businesses**


Some companies, particularly retail and clothing businesses, may have a hard time efficiently using systems that are too complex for them.


According to Guru, businesses need a billing solution that is straightforward, fast, and easy to use.


That’s exactly what Swipe achieved for G1 Clothing.


Instead of complicating daily operations, the app enables the team to generate billing invoices, manage payment operations, and stay in touch with customers easily.


For Guru, Swipe brought this type of billing solution to the company’s work routine.


## **Final thoughts**


The running of a clothing shop consists of managing customers, products, employees, payments, and multiple other routines of the day. Billing software should facilitate running one of these activities instead of complicating it even more.


G1 Clothing’s experience with Swipe illustrates how simple billing software for retail businesses makes getting invoices ready and minimises the manual work to be done.


Due to being web-based, user-friendly, and having the possibility of sending invoices via WhatsApp, Swipe helps Guru and his team to speed up and simplify billing processes.
